concerns.text: Consumer-before-producer within US2: T025 ('Error-rate aggregation ... in code/analysis/stats.py. Dependency: T024') aggregates translation error rates from execution_logs.csv, but the rows it reads are only written by T026 ('Translation errors logged alongside latency in data/processed/execution_logs.csv ... Dependency: T025'). T026 depends on T025 while T025 consumes T026's output — a circular/wrong-direction dependency. Logging (T026) must precede aggregation (T025), and T026's stated dependency on T025 should be on T024 instead.

T012 is tagged [P] ('Implement code/main.py orchestration: load config, generate queries, route to executors, log raw metrics') but it consumes T005 (config), T006/T007 (generators), T008–T011 (executors), and T016b (validate_throttling_effectiveness is 'called from code/main.py'). An orchestration task with five upstream producers is not parallel-safe; the [P] tag must be removed and explicit dependencies declared.

The three executor tasks are tagged [P] with no dependency on T016 (CPU throttle) or T016c (data fetcher), yet FR-001 requires every latency measurement to run under enforced CPU/memory limits and the executors execute 'real queries against the sampled/streamed ... subset' fetched by T016c. As written they could be executed before the throttle or data loader exists, producing FR-001-invalid latencies. Declare 'Dependency: T016, T016c' (T009 also T006) or drop [P].

T021 ('Implement data persistence in code/main.py writing raw metrics ... Dependency: T015, T017, T016') omits T012 (main.py itself), T008–T011 (executors that produce the metrics), and T016b (abort check called from main.py). The stated dependency set is incomplete relative to the task's own description; add them so the execution order line ('T016 → T016b/T008 → T021') matches the per-task dependency declarations.

T030 (viz) declares 'Dependency: T021, T026' but T026 sits later in the Phase 3 list than T018/T020 which also read execution_logs.csv; more importantly T018/T020 declare only 'Dependency: T021' while T030 requires T026 (translation errors in the CSV) — if T026 is genuinely needed for the CSV to be complete, T018/T020 share that dependency and should declare it; if not, drop it from T030. Make the CSV-completeness point consistent across all consumers.
